data.donor: Exact AF-05 changed selected-Q donor with identical graph and semantically untouched facts; composed recipient/donor Horn truth is independently recomputed.
data.evaluation: Hold out all scored split cases until fixed optimizer checkpoints are exported.
data.input_features: Initial fact bits, public rule incidence/roles only. Derived Q0/Q1 truth, goal, donor labels and downstream closure excluded from features.
data.source: AF-05 unchanged Horn graph + least-fixed-point oracle

failure_policy: Engineering green is independent from registered science pass/fail. Keep original AF-01..AF-08 source/results unchanged and AF-09 PR draft and unmerged.

fitting.addressed_schedule: Same monotone ramp as AF-08 with status mask always off; no post-hoc tuning.
fitting.checkpoint_selection: Only final fixed step 160, never choose by heldout; keep all seeds, failing arms and raw logits.
fitting.compute_caveat: Optimizer steps and native-cell forward calls are matched. Margin terms add arithmetic and backward FLOPs, which must be reported separately.
fitting.forward_call_fairness: Each arm uses two source prefixes, clean suffix, main patch suffix and other-subgoal negative-control suffix per training row and update.
fitting.init_rng: Keep original AF-08 per-seed continuation RNG and donor draws; no heldout-dependent selection.
fitting.loss_common: The exact AF-08 clean goal/Q initial/final/stepwise CE, patched goal/Q/stepwise CE, control goal/stepwise CE and 0.025 parameter-distance anchor.
fitting.loss_locality: The original AF-07 0.25 protected-Q probability KL +0.04 carried-code MSE under ramped addressed patch exposure.
fitting.loss_semantic_margin: Identical to locality including addressed patch exposure, plus +0.30 signed-certificate softplus and +0.15 actual patched true-margin softplus at all downstream 3 steps.
fitting.loss_status: With addressed mask off; irrelevant-subgoal-only patch.
fitting.parent_weights: Every arm starts from the exact same qualified per-seed warm-up tensors.

hypothesis: Differentiably maximizing the certificate for true-class protected-subgoal margin after an addressed intervention improves held-out depth-4 and depth-5 causally local proof state relative to equal-forward-call causal locality alone.

mathematical_contract.actual_code: z_{t,Q} is the two-float code after each native cell call and encoder tanh, before the affine decoder. Decoded cell inputs are resident.
mathematical_contract.controls: Retain clean and patched true-class margins, exact sensitivity K, actual before-decoder code pairs and drift, stepwise certificate truth, false-certificate count. No model-produced target labels.
mathematical_contract.decoder: D(z)=W_D z+b_D, original atom LearnedCodec decoder
mathematical_contract.exact_certificate: m_y(z_patch) >= m_y(z_clean)-K_y ||z_patch-z_clean||_2. Strictly positive lower bound certifies patched correctness if true clean label y is used.
mathematical_contract.interpretation: The certificate is exact for affine decoder/head composed with arbitrary nonlinear recurrence; it is sufficient for subgoal classification only, not downstream goal truth or global invertibility.
mathematical_contract.loss: L_certificate=mean_addressed,step softplus(0.5 - [m_y(z_clean)-K_y ||delta||_2]); L_patched=mean_addressed,step softplus(0.5-m_y(z_patch)). Added to locality arm as +0.30 L_certificate +0.15 L_patched.
mathematical_contract.margin: m_y(z)=R(D(z))[y]-R(D(z))[1-y] where y is the independent exact recipient Horn truth of the semantically untouched Q.
mathematical_contract.numerics: Use torch.linalg.vector_norm with defined zero subgradient; fail on nonfinite losses/gradients/weights; verify bound with 1e-4 numerical tolerance in float32, and reconstruct using NumPy float64 in independent scorer.

parent_source.original_cell: Original source-hash-pinned TypedLoop, shared GraphLooper model, 29 tokens, 16 working floats each, 2 actual float32 carried coordinates per token.
parent_source.qualification: Each original shared warm-up has exactly 1.0 train/dev goal and joint-Q scores and passes checksum, checkpoint and receipt checks before training.

scoring.certification: Native Lean 4.19.0 checks the 4,176 closed synthetic Boolean-Horn oracle theorems, independent of learned neural proof predictions.
scoring.eligibility: The original qualified source and each compared status, locality and semantic_margin continuation must separately reach >=0.90 original goal and exact joint-Q on train and dev.
scoring.engineering: Recompute every retained oracle, cross-check all code/margin/certificate arrays independently in NumPy, evaluate all checkpoint source and output hashes, and replay at least two retained pairs per split/arm from actual Torch weights.
scoring.extra_timing: 3 and 5 downstream calls for depth 4 and depth 5, 3 otherwise; five-call case receives tensor-only recurrence diagnostic.
scoring.followup: Scientific failure and missing qualification remain labeled; subsequent changes require a new registration.
metrics: clean original goal and exact Q
scoring.primary_gate: In each eligible seed and at each depth 4 and 5, semantic_margin - locality protected-Q last-step accuracy >=0.05, semantic_margin protected-Q >=0.90, irrelevant patch goal retention >=0.90, clean goal drop vs locality <=0.03, no additional false positive goal attempts; additionally positive-certificate rate increases >=0.05 relative to locality at the final step and no certificate contradicts observed truth. Any eligible failure is registered aggregate FAIL; all seeds eligible and pass is PASS; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

title: Signed true-class causal margin across recurrent Horn proof dependencies
